trechos.trecho: The purchasing process is meticulously misleading, making you believe you are buying a one-hour class when in fact you are subscribing to a monthly plan.

trechos.trecho: DON'T USE THIS WEBSITE. They scammed me out of £78 and my friend out of £200...They don't respond to emails.

trechos.trecho: They will not stop texting me. You can't reply stop and even after emailing them they will not stop texting me.
